attachments.origin_landmark: iliac crest, sacrum, common erector spinae tendon
attachments.insertion_landmark: angles of ribs 3-12; cervicis part to transverse processes C4-C6

innervation.root_levels: segmental (C4-L1, matching level of each fascicle)

functional_compartments.name: Iliocostalis lumborum
functional_compartments.function_note: Most lateral, most caudal column; origin from the broad common erector spinae aponeurosis over the sacrum/iliac crest.
functional_compartments.source: Bogduk N, Macintosh JE, Pearcy MJ (1992) Spine 17(8):897-913 -- quantitative model of lumbar back muscle architecture and moment arms (erector spinae, multifidus, quadratus lumborum)

functional_compartments.name: Iliocostalis thoracis
functional_compartments.function_note: Overlapping short fascicles linking rib angles across ~6 levels each; classic 'bootstrap' segmental architecture of the erector spinae.
functional_compartments.source: Bogduk N, Macintosh JE, Pearcy MJ (1992) Spine 17(8):897-913 -- quantitative model of lumbar back muscle architecture and moment arms (erector spinae, multifidus, quadratus lumborum)

functional_compartments.name: Iliocostalis cervicis
functional_compartments.function_note: Smallest, most cranial part; continues the lateral column from upper rib angles to lower cervical transverse processes.
functional_compartments.source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998)

source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998); Bogduk N, Macintosh JE, Pearcy MJ (1992) Spine 17(8):897-913 -- quantitative model of lumbar back muscle architecture and moment arms (erector spinae, multifidus, quadratus lumborum)
